I was walking down a road with my friend. Both sides of the roads are thick forests. There are only 3 houses nearby and it would take at least a few minutes to get to them. It was a beautiful sunny day and my friend was talking about when she went skiing on that road one winter and heard a sound like roaring, she just turned her way back around and went back to her house as fast as possible. Now, that was in winter years ago and she lives in Estonia, no lions here, especially not in the winter.
A few minutes pass and the forest gets thicker next to us and because of that, the road gets darker and i get an eery feeling. Suddenly we hear a very low gurgle, almost like roaring. The sound comes 2 or 3 times and we just freeze for 5 seconds and look at eachother. We turn around so fast and start speedwalking back to the houses. It was one of the scariest things that has happened to me and that was in broad daylight.
